name: Box Maker
description: Make a tray or box that prints without supports: dividers, lids, a handle or wall screws, or a box that prints flat and folds up

name: Bag Maker
description: Make a bag with handles and a raised pattern, printed in one piece in TPU

name: Stamp Maker
description: Make an ink stamp from words, a border and a logo, with a handle

name: Star Map
description: Make a two-colour card of the real night sky over a place, on a date you choose

name: Picture Frame
description: Make a picture frame that pins together, with a back, clips, a stand and a mat

name: Mask
description: Make a thin lace carnival mask that prints flat, with loops at the sides for elastic or ribbon

name: Card Embosser
description: Make rollers that press a pattern, logo or words into business cards as you turn a crank

name: Tulle Card Wrap
description: Print gold lines onto tulle that fold round a piece of card, with a name on the front, over Art Deco lines, roses, lace, daisies, leaves, hearts, stars, snowflakes or scallops

name: Phone Case
description: Make a case for your phone, with a pattern, words or a picture on the back, a grip, a card wallet or a stand

name: Lightbox
description: Make a box lit from inside, with your words or a picture on the front

name: Lampshade
description: Make a lampshade that fits your lamp holder, in a shape and pattern you choose

name: Lithophane
description: Make a picture that shows when light shines through it: flat, curved, round or as a lamp
